entries.description: Deploy and manage GPU workloads: deployments, jobs, GPU markets, credits, nodes and network statistics.
representativeQueries: deploy an nginx container on an NVIDIA 4090 GPU
what does an hour on an H100 cost on Nosana
how many credits do I have left
stop the deployment that is running my model

entries.description: Procedural knowledge for driving Nosana with the @nosana/kit TypeScript SDK: creating and starting deployments, picking a market, reading endpoint readiness, reading logs, and handling credits and errors.
representativeQueries: write TypeScript that deploys a model on Nosana
why did my Nosana deployment never start serving
which Nosana GPU market should I use

entries.description: OAuth-protected tools for choosing GPU markets and creating, monitoring, scaling, stopping and debugging Nosana deployments.
representativeQueries: which Nosana GPU market should I use
why is my deployment not serving

identity.note: This catalog is served from the publisher's own domain over HTTPS.

source.note: Nosana publishes its SDK and Agent Skill as open source; the MCP server card and endpoint are served from Nosana-controlled production domains.

integrity.note: Pinned to an immutable commit; the digest is over the artifact's raw bytes.
The server card is published on Nosana’s controlled domain and points to the OAuth-protected production MCP endpoint.
